title: Service agreement records from practice session C

context.question: Who must perform each narrow task, and what does the supplied evidence demonstrate?

controls.evidence_note: No current OS assurance evidence was supplied.
Provider release evidence covers the delivered application binary.
Tenant report sharing includes an unapproved external group.
Sales sheet mentions resilient service but does not identify a backup operator.
No acceptance owner or restored-record check was supplied.

artifacts.service-description.txt:
Fictional agreement. No cloud account exists.
C1 Orchard Desk is SaaS: the provider runs the OS and the delivered application binary. There is no customer extension code in scope.
C2 The tenant administrator chooses users and report sharing settings.
C3 The supplied sales sheet says resilient service. It gives no backup-copy operator, copy scope, retention promise or restore procedure. Treat these omissions as unanswered questions.
C4 The customer determines whether recovered records meet its business needs.
artifacts.checks.txt:
Synthetic supplied evidence.
E1 No current OS assurance evidence was supplied. Team claims provider owns OS patching.
E2 Provider release evidence covers the delivered application binary. Team writes shared for code patching.
E3 Tenant report sharing includes an unapproved external group. Team claims provider owns sharing settings.
E4 Sales sheet mentions resilient service but does not identify a backup operator. Team claims provider creates copies.
E5 No acceptance owner or restored-record check was supplied. Team has no assignment.
